empty: You haven't registered any products yet.
too_many_decimals: Amounts allow at most 2 decimal places.
composition_cycle: That relationship forms a cycle: one of the products would end up containing itself. Remove the reverse composition before adding this one.

form.barcodeHint: The one printed on the supplier's package: it is what the scanner reads at the point of sale. If the product has none, leave it empty and use only the internal code.
form.codesRequired: Enter at least one of the two codes: the barcode (if the package has one) or the internal code.
form.costHint: What one unit costs you from your supplier, before taxes. Never shown to the customer. Optional: leave it empty if you don't know it yet — empty means «not captured», zero means «it costs $0».
form.isComposite: Built from other products in the catalog
form.name: Name
form.priceHint: What you charge the customer for one unit. This is the price the point of sale puts on the receipt.
form.skuHint: The identifier YOUR business uses for this product, unique across the catalog. If you leave it empty, the barcode will be used.
form.stockMinHint: When stock drops below this amount, the product shows as «below minimum» so you can restock. Leave 0 to skip the warning.
form.tracksLots: This product is tracked by lot and expiry date
form.tracksLotsLocked: Cannot be turned off: there is still stock assigned to lots. Move it out or consume it first.
